name: reels
description: Instagram Reels open while Claude is working, and close when the turn ends or Claude is waiting on you

browser.title: Open in
browser.description: auto: the Claude desktop app's browser pane where the session has one, a window of its own elsewhere (the terminal has no pane). window: always the window

side.title: Side
side.description: Which edge of the main screen the window is docked against, top to bottom (Windows)

width.title: Width
width.description: How much of the screen's width the window takes (Windows)

browserPath.title: Browser
browserPath.description: Full path of the Edge or Chrome executable the window runs in; empty finds an installed one
